Name: Jesus Justus
Summary: Jesus, called Justus, was one of Paul's fellowworkers of the circumcision who were a comfort to him. He is a different man from Jesus Christ.
KeyStory: Jesus, called Justus, was one of Paul's fellowworkers of the circumcision who were a comfort to him. He is a different man from Jesus Christ.
LifeLesson: A shared name does not make a shared identity; Scripture keeps its people distinct.
